metadata.label: Ontario Science and Technology Grade 3 curriculum

ontario-science-g3-all-strands.documentTitle: Ontario Science and Technology Grade 3 - Overall Expectations

standards.summaryText: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures
standards.officialOutcomeText: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures

standards.summaryText: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life
standards.officialOutcomeText: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences

standards.summaryText: assess ways in which plants are beneficial to society and the environment, and ways in which human activity has an impact on plants and plant habitats
standards.officialOutcomeText: assess ways in which plants are beneficial to society and the environment, and ways in which human activity has an impact on plants and plant habitats
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of characteristics and uses of plants and of plants’ responses to the natural environment
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of characteristics and uses of plants and of plants’ responses to the natural environment

standards.summaryText: assess the impacts of various forces on society and the environment
standards.officialOutcomeText: assess the impacts of various forces on society and the environment
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of how forces cause motion and changes in motion
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of how forces cause motion and changes in motion

standards.summaryText: assess the importance of form, function, strength, and stability in structures to society and the environment
standards.officialOutcomeText: assess the importance of form, function, strength, and stability in structures to society and the environment
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of the concepts of strength and stability as they relate to structures with various forms and functions, and of the factors that affect structures’ strength and stability
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of the concepts of strength and stability as they relate to structures with various forms and functions, and of the factors that affect structures’ strength and stability

standards.summaryText: assess the importance of soils for society and the environment, and the impact of human activity on soils
standards.officialOutcomeText: assess the importance of soils for society and the environment, and the impact of human activity on soils
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of the composition of soils, of different types of soils, and of processes and practices that can affect the health of soil
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of the composition of soils, of different types of soils, and of processes and practices that can affect the health of soil
